channel.title: AE Tax Advisors — Business and Real Estate Owners
channel.description: Tax planning articles for business owners and real estate owners.

item.title: Tax Preparer Made a Mistake? An Owner’s Next Steps | AE Tax
item.description: Found a possible mistake on a business or rental tax return? Gather the evidence, separate filing errors from planning choices and map the correction.

item.title: Sold Rental Still on Your Depreciation Schedule? | AE Tax
item.description: Review rental sale reporting, asset retirement and sale-year depreciation when a sold property remains active on the tax depreciation schedule.

item.title: Review Your Business and Rental Return Before Signing | AE Tax
item.description: A practical pre-signing tax return review for owners: check entities, rental properties, payments, asset changes and the final filing authorization.

item.title: Rental Partnership Refinance: Distribution and Basis | AE Tax
item.description: Before a rental partnership distributes refinance proceeds, reconcile each partner’s outside basis, liability share and cash distribution.

item.title: Deducting the Whole Rental Mortgage Payment: A Mistake | AE Tax
item.description: Rental owners should separate mortgage principal, interest and escrow. Review lender statements and Schedule E before deducting the whole payment.

item.title: K-1 Capital Account Is Not Partnership Outside Basis | AE Tax
item.description: Business and rental partners should not use K-1 tax capital as outside basis. Review contributions, distributions, debt and loss-limit worksheets.

item.title: Electing Out of Bonus Depreciation by Asset Class | AE Tax
item.description: Business and property owners should model bonus depreciation elections by asset class, including other purchases, future income and state differences.

item.title: Cost Segregation Report: Basis Reconciliation Checklist | AE Tax
item.description: Check a completed cost segregation report against land, building basis, prior depreciation and separately purchased assets before implementing it.

item.title: Cost Segregation on a Related-Party Purchase | AE Tax
item.description: Buying a building from family or another entity you own? Separate cost segregation from bonus eligibility before projecting a first-year deduction.

item.title: Changing Tax Preparers: Owner Carryforward Checklist | AE Tax
item.description: Transfer business basis, rental losses, depreciation and payment records when changing tax preparers so opening balances can be verified.

item.title: Estimated Tax Payments Missing From an Owner’s Return | AE Tax
item.description: Reconcile missing estimated tax payments by taxpayer, tax year and agency before paying twice or filing an unnecessary amended return.

item.title: Equipment Trade-In: Basis and Depreciation Recapture | AE Tax
item.description: Trading in business equipment can create a taxable disposition. Separate the old asset’s gain from the new asset’s cost before forecasting deductions.

item.title: Equipment Delivered in December but Not Operational | AE Tax
item.description: A deposit or December delivery does not settle depreciation timing. Business owners should document installation, readiness and actual equipment use.

item.title: Business Credit-Card Expenses Deducted Twice | AE Tax
item.description: Learn how imported card charges and bank payments can duplicate business expenses, what records to reconcile and how to review a filed return.

item.title: Upper-Tier Partnership Got Form 8986: Pay or Push Out?
item.description: Your upper-tier partnership received Form 8986. Compare paying the imputed underpayment with pushing adjustments to investors, and check the filing deadline.

item.title: Unequal S Corp Distributions: Is the Election at Risk?
item.description: Paid one S corp owner more than another? Check the governing rights, shareholder basis, and correction path before filing Form 1120-S.

item.title: Inherited S Corp Stock in a Trust: Election Deadline
item.description: Founder died and S corp shares remain in a revocable trust? Map the two-year eligibility window, QSST or ESBT election, and late-relief path.

item.title: Stock Purchase and Building Cost Segregation | AE Tax
item.description: Buying stock in an S corporation that owns a commercial building? Learn when the buyer gets new property basis for cost segregation and what to model before closing.

item.title: S Corp Owner Died Before Sale: Who Reports the Gain?
item.description: An S corporation owner died before an asset sale. Compare daily K-1 allocation, a Section 1377 election, estate stock basis, and return records.

item.title: Partnership Section 737: Is a Property Swap Taxable?
item.description: Contributed appreciated real estate to a partnership? Before taking a different property, test Section 737 gain, outside basis, and the seven-year rule.

item.title: Partnership Mortgage Forgiveness Before a Sale: Tax?
item.description: A lender will forgive partnership mortgage debt before a sale. See who reports cancellation income, which exclusions partners test, and the records needed.

item.title: Partnership Distributes Mortgaged Property: Tax?
item.description: If a partnership distributes a mortgaged building to one partner, another partner may have gain from debt relief without cash. See the basis and filing checks.

item.title: Cash Partner Redemption and Section 734(b) | AE Tax
item.description: Redeeming a real estate partner for cash? See when Section 734(b) changes remaining-property basis, what can be depreciated, and why bonus differs.

item.title: Partnership Cash-Out Refi: Is the Payout Taxable?
item.description: Your property partnership refinanced and paid owners cash. Test each partner's outside basis, debt share, and possible gain before treating the payout as tax-free.

item.title: Partner Died Before Sale: Section 754 Step-Up?
item.description: A partner died before the real estate partnership sold. See why inherited interest basis and a Section 743(b) adjustment are different—and what the executor should check.

item.title: Landlord Pays Tenant to Exit Commercial Lease: Tax?
item.description: Landlord paying your operating business to surrender a commercial lease? Section 1241 treats the lease payment as an exchange, but character and other payouts differ.

item.title: Tenant Lease-Cancellation Fee Before a Sale | AE Tax
item.description: A commercial tenant paid to end its lease before your building sale. Is the fee rent or sale gain? See the return split, closing example, and records to keep.

item.title: Cash-Basis Business Sale: Who Pays Tax on Receivables?
item.description: Selling a cash-basis business with unpaid invoices? See how receivables affect ordinary income, Form 8594 and the sale-year return.

item.title: Distribute C-Corp Real Estate Before a Sale? | AE Tax
item.description: Selling a C corporation that owns appreciated real estate? Model the corporate gain and shareholder distribution before moving the building out of the company.

item.title: Buying Business Assets With Unpaid Form 941 Taxes?
item.description: Buying a business whose seller owes Form 941 payroll taxes? Check entity debt, tax liens, successor liability, and closing records before choosing an asset deal.

item.title: Is Rollover Equity Taxable at Closing? | AE Tax
item.description: Selling a business to private equity and keeping a stake? Learn when rollover equity may defer gain, when cash is taxable, and what to review before signing.

item.title: Buyer Assumed My Business Debt: What Goes on Form 8594?
item.description: If a buyer assumes debt in your business asset sale, reconcile cash, liabilities, Form 8594 and the sale return before filing.

item.title: Buying a Business: Are Deal Fees Deductible? | AE Tax
item.description: Buying an operating business? Separate diligence, closing, financing and success-based banker fees before deciding what to deduct or capitalize.

item.title: S Corp Buyout With Company Cash: Redemption or Sale?
item.description: Used S-corp cash to buy out a co-owner? Trace the stock buyer, cash flow, basis, and K-1s before filing. Book a return review with AE Tax.

item.title: S Corp Real Estate Distribution: What Goes on the Returns?
item.description: An S corporation transferred appreciated real estate to an owner. See the gain, K-1, stock-basis, and 1040 steps to review before filing. Book a return review.

item.title: Can My Syndication Deduct Offering Costs? | AE Tax
item.description: Raising capital for a real estate deal? Separate placement and offering costs from partnership formation costs before filing Form 1065 and investor K-1s.

item.title: Can a Landlord Deduct a Cash-for-Keys Tenant Buyout? | AE Tax
item.description: Paying a tenant to leave before a sale or renovation? See when a landlord must capitalize the buyout, how the 12-month rule works, and what to document.

item.title: Gift a Rental With Suspended Losses? | AE Tax Advisors
item.description: Gifting a rental to your child with suspended passive losses? See why the gift does not release a deduction, how basis changes, and what to review before signing.

item.title: Travel Costs When Buying Rental Property | AE Tax
item.description: Travel to buy rental property may be deductible, capitalized, a startup cost, or personal. Apply the purpose, timing, and existing-business tests.

item.title: Can I Use the Seller's Cost Segregation Study? | AE Tax
item.description: Bought a rental with the seller's cost segregation study? Learn what you can reuse, what must be revalued for your basis, and what to review before filing.

item.title: Buyer Defaulted on a Seller Note: Amend the Sale Return?
item.description: The buyer defaulted on your company-sale note. Learn when to keep, revise, or separately report the installment obligation before amending a return.

item.title: Business Sale Transition Payments: Price or Consulting?
item.description: Selling a company and staying to help the buyer? See when transition payments may be service income rather than sale proceeds and what to review before signing.

item.title: Can I 1031 Into a Vacation Home? | AE Tax Advisors
item.description: Selling a rental and eyeing a vacation home? Test the IRS 24-month, fair-rent and personal-use safe harbor before signing the 1031 exchange documents.

item.title: What Happens to Suspended Rental Losses at Death? | AE Tax Advisors
item.description: Suspended passive rental losses do not simply transfer to heirs. See how the basis increase can reduce the deduction on the decedent's final return.

item.title: Can Spouse and Co-Host Hours Count for STR Material Participation?
item.description: Learn whose hours count toward short-term rental material participation, how co-host work affects the 100-hour test, and what records to keep.

item.title: Do STR Maintenance Days Count as Personal Use? | AE Tax Advisors
item.description: Vacation-home rules can limit STR deductions. Learn when owner stays, family stays, and substantial maintenance days count as personal use.

item.title: Is a Short-Term Rental 27.5- or 39-Year Property? | AE Tax Advisors
item.description: A seven-day average stay does not automatically decide an STR building's depreciation period. Apply the separate residential-rental and transient-lodging rules.

item.title: S Corp Midyear Sale: Who Reports the Year's Profit?
item.description: Selling an S corp midyear? Compare daily K-1 allocation with a closing-of-books election, owner consents, stock basis, and what to review before filing.

item.title: Converted C Corp to S Corp: Is Our Payout a Dividend?
item.description: Planning a large payout after a C-to-S conversion? Separate AAA, old C-corp earnings, dividends, shareholder basis, and required reporting before paying cash.

item.title: Do Seller Credits Reduce Rental Property Basis? | AE Tax
item.description: Bought a rental with seller credits? Separate a price concession from loan costs, tax prorations, and repair escrow before depreciating the property. Book a review.
